name: mastery-queue
description: Local-first PWA that turns the Skills Mastery Roadmap into a daily queue of ~25-minute lessons.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-content.ts && npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/content-check.ts --dist && node scripts/check-size.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.sw.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json
